nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML entry point that bootstraps the React application, loading fonts, favicon, and the main JavaScript module.

nodes.name: .env
nodes.summary: Environment configuration file defining runtime settings for Node.js server including database connection, JWT secrets, and admin user credentials.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains sensitive credentials (JWT secrets, admin password) that must not be committed to version control.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm package manifest defining AlpineScout application metadata, production and development dependencies, and build/test scripts.

nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: VS Code editor settings configuring default formatter to Prettier with format-on-save enabled.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Guidelines document for AI agents working on this repository, covering development, production checks, deployment, and coding conventions.

nodes.name: AUDIT.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Phase 0 audit report documenting routes inventory, environment variables, SQL query patterns, authentication flow, file upload handling, database schema, security observations, and Docker container state.

nodes.name: PRODUCTION.md
nodes.summary: Production deployment guide for GCP Compute Engine covering VM creation, Docker installation, secrets configuration, deployment procedures, local MVP testing, data import, backups, and security checklist.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview documentation with local setup instructions and development checks for the Bumpy Road application.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security documentation detailing the AlpineScout threat model, security controls for authentication, RBAC, input validation, file uploads, network isolation, and container security, plus accepted risks and security checklist.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Design thinking principles and frontend aesthetics guidelines for maintaining consistent UI/UX standards.

nodes.name: master_prompt.md
nodes.summary: Master build prompt documenting the complete 6-phase development plan for AlpineScout including audit, containerization, backend security hardening, network hardening, documentation, verification, and data ingestion.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose configuration defining multi-container orchestration with services, custom bridge networks, and persistent volumes for the AlpineScout application stack.
